Platform administrators only. Lists real fulfillment territories in the authenticated tenant and selected country with current organization bindings.

put.description: Fresh MFA, CSRF, platform administrator, existing same-scope business territory and active territory node required. Revision and reason are recorded atomically with append-only binding evidence.

get.summary: Read current scoped fulfillment resources from the owning service
get.description: Authenticated operator identity, selected country and mapped role are derived from the current server session. Client authority query parameters are rejected. The owning service enforces live staff assignments and consent.

get.summary: Read current explicit field-command territory IDs
get.description: Advisory controls use current explicit resource.command assignments. A global operator role alone grants no field attendance authority. The owning command rechecks at execution and replay.

post.summary: Record an assigned field visit through the fulfillment owner
post.description: Current server session, fresh MFA and CSRF are required. Only point and Idempotency-Key are accepted. The owning service rechecks explicit current territorial resource.command scope before execution or idempotency replay, then enforces its geofence. A timeout is an unknown result; retry the identical point with the same key.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present only for an acknowledged prior visit.

get.summary: List audience criteria in the current organization scope
get.description: Tenant, selected country, subject and MFA are derived from the current operator session. Up to 100 currently authorized groups per page, ordered by immutable ID. Continue with next_cursor as after; no cursor grants access. Scope is rechecked on every page. No query authority is accepted.

next_cursor.description: Present only when another currently authorized page exists.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The previous page next_cursor, a canonical lowercase UUID. Omit for the first page.

post.description: Current server session, actual MFA, fresh authentication and CSRF are required. The owning transaction locks the live directory account/source session and current organization scope through commit. Caller tenant/country/actor fields are rejected. Revision must be zero for a new group. Criteria do not grant record permissions.

put.summary: Update audience criteria at the current revision
put.description: Current server session, actual MFA, fresh authentication and CSRF are required. The owning transaction locks the live directory account/source session and current organization scope through commit. Caller tenant/country/actor fields are rejected. An outdated revision conflicts without mutation. Before/after scope management is required when moving a group. Criteria versions and audit commit atomically.

post.summary: Check current membership without exposing a member list
post.description: Current server session, actual MFA, fresh authentication and CSRF are required. The owning transaction locks the live directory account/source session and current organization scope through commit. Caller tenant/country/actor fields are rejected. Current staff-management authority over the group is required. Suspended assignments, inactive ancestors and disabled groups do not match.

200.description: Bounded spreadsheet-safe operational CSV; private, no-store

get.summary: Export current authorized regional operational counters
get.description: Requires fresh MFA and current operator directory/source-session revision. The owning service holds directory, session and organization locks through export audit commit, derives country-wide authority from the live directory and requires both read and export permission for every included territory. Caller authority query parameters are rejected. Excludes payouts, rider locations and other-person attendance. UTC day boundaries match the regional dashboard. No persistent export download token or public URL is created.

get.summary: List current-country reference data using current operator authority
get.description: Super/country administrators and auditors only. Literal search, stable ID pagination and active/inactive filters. Tenant and country come from the server session.

put.summary: Create or revise country reference data with atomic change evidence
put.description: Requires current super/country administration, MFA, fresh source authentication and CSRF. Revision zero creates. Kind, code and parent are immutable. Active children prevent parent deactivation. This does not alter country currency, tax or launch configuration.

409.description: Revision, stable identity or active-child conflict

404.description: No entry in the current tenant/country

get.summary: List safe participant application summaries using the current country administrator session
get.description: Current country administrators see their selected country. Regional staff see only explicitly bound participants under live active territory ancestors and inherited resource.read. Actions separately require resource.command. Fresh source session and directory revision are checked in the owning transaction.

200.description: Current-country review projection or regional queue without document and bank metadata

post.summary: Record an owning revisioned rejection with a reason
post.description: Fresh MFA, CSRF, current country or bound regional participant command authority, independent participant, original expected revision and idempotency key are required. Retry the same command on response loss. No approval bypass is exposed.

post.summary: Record a vendor application field visit using current location
post.description: Fresh MFA, CSRF, current country or bound regional resource.command authority, a scheduled owner visit, owner distance validation, original expected revision and idempotency key are required. FIELD_OFFICER is only the owning protocol role; current operator source authority is checked by the owner.

get.description: Current country administrators with fresh MFA can read redacted review evidence. Bound regional staff can read a minimal vendor summary without contact, document, bank or decision fields. Both require an owner source lock; private asset IDs, extracted fields and bank references are omitted.

200.description: Country review evidence or minimal regional vendor summary

post.summary: Open one stored private application document for an authorized reviewer
post.description: Requires a current country admin session, fresh MFA, CSRF and current participant read scope. The owner resolves the document by its stored kind, verifies READY media and issues a short lived grant. The response is no-store and omits the asset ID.

200.description: Short lived private access grant. Cache-Control: no-store.

post.summary: Record a country application review decision
post.description: Requires current COUNTRY_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN, fresh MFA, CSRF, owner revision and idempotency key. Bank verification additionally requires an explicitly assigned FINANCE operator role. Vendor VERIFY_KYC requires private media and independent OCR and KYC results bound to the current document set and revision. Rider APPROVE requires private media, independent KYC and bank verification. Provider absence or rejection leaves the owner state unchanged; real provider configuration is deployment dependent.

get.description: Current COUNTRY_ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN with policy capability, fresh MFA and selected-country scope. Query parameters are rejected.

post.description: Create a scoped proposal. Requires fresh country administrator MFA, current operator revision, policy capability and CSRF. Publication requires a separate command.

get.description: Read one proposal in the selected country and current administrator authority.

post.description: Publish a previously proposed country policy using a different fresh MFA administrator and CSRF. Request body must be empty; owner validates proposal and revision.

get.description: List scoped deletion requests and aggregate owner/hold counts. Query parameters are rejected.
Read a deletion request in the current tenant and selected country.

post.description: Place a scoped owner hold with a durable reason reference. Requires fresh MFA administrator authority and CSRF.

get.description: Read scoped deletion holds under current country administrator authority. Query parameters are rejected.

post.description: Release one hold at its expected revision with a reason reference. Requires a different fresh MFA administrator from the holder and CSRF.
